notes: Multi Studio version 2.3.5: **Markdown Script Importer in Script Studio**: You can now import scripts formatted in Markdown (`.md`, `.markdown`) and plain text (`.txt`) directly into Script Studio. Organize scripts by scene headings (e.g., `### Scene 01`) and divider lines (`---`), preview sections and block characters in real-time, customize section naming presets (`01, 02...`, `01 - Title`, `Section 01`, or custom prefixes like `Scene` or `Act`), and drag and drop script files directly into the studio., **Movable & Resizable Script Importer Window**: The script importer window can now be freely repositioned anywhere on your screen by dragging the top title bar, and resized from any edge or corner grip, providing comfortable space for reviewing long narrative scripts. A dedicated reset button in the window header lets you quickly return the dialog to its centered default size and position., **Persistent Script Importer State**: Closing or reopening the script importer window no longer clears your typed text or settings, safely preserving your work in progress until you choose to import or click the dedicated "Reset" action button., **Enhanced Duplicate Block Recognition**: Duplicate audio blocks now feature distinct warm warning styling on their block name tags, making repeated text passages immediately identifiable at a glance., **Wider Block Name Field**: Expanded the block name input field to comfortably display longer scene labels (such as "01 - Scene 01") without truncation., **Smart Markdown Paste Recognition**: Pasting scripts with Markdown headings into the Script Studio editor now automatically detects your scene structure and offers quick one-click import, keeping your section names organized without reading out raw markdown symbols as spoken text., **Clean Block Naming Without Forced Suffixes**: Removed unwanted numeric suffixes (such as `- 01`, `- 02`) when importing or pasting script sections. Blocks now cleanly adopt your chosen section naming style (`01`, `02`, `Scene 01`, etc.) without unintended trailing numbers., **Remember Dialog Size & Position**: The Script Importer now automatically saves your customized window size and screen position. When you restart the application and open the importer again, it reopens at the exact same size and position you left it., **Synchronized Blank-Line Splitting**: Added a dedicated "Split blocks by blank lines" control directly inside the Script Importer dialog that syncs with your studio preference. When turned off, narrative scenes are preserved together as complete blocks instead of being split up at every blank line., **Optimized Windows Application Setup & Streamlined AI Transcriber**: Streamlined the Windows version by focusing on Google Gemini cloud transcription models, eliminating heavy and complex local build requirements on Windows PCs. Whisper local transcription remains available on macOS with Apple Silicon GPU acceleration., **Dedicated Gemini Transcriber on Windows**: The AI Transcriber interface now automatically presents a clean, dedicated Google Gemini engine layout on Windows, featuring Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe with automatic subtitle timing and multi-language support., **Reliable Script Importer Dialog Visibility & Smooth Moving**: Fixed an issue where the movable Script Importer dialog failed to appear or rendered off-screen when clicking "Import Markdown Script". The dialog now always opens centered, moves smoothly across the entire screen, and centers perfectly when clicking the reset button., **TTS Studio Brand Colors**: Updated all script importer buttons, drag-and-drop borders, and checkbox accents to match TTS Studio's signature indigo and purple brand theme, keeping amber reserved strictly for duplicate text warnings and alerts., **Fixed-Height Script Text Area for Long Pastes**: Fixed an issue where pasting very long scripts caused the editor textarea to automatically grow downward and distort the Live Sections Preview height. The textarea now maintains a clean, fixed height with internal scrolling regardless of script length., **Dynamic Height Layout on Script Importer Resizing**: Updated the Script Text editor and Live Sections Preview to dynamically expand and fill all available vertical space when resizing the dialog, docking the Section Naming Style panel cleanly at the bottom and eliminating awkward blank space., **Minimum Window Size Safeguard**: Enforced the default dialog dimensions (1000px × 720px) as the minimum resize boundary for the Script Importer, preventing the modal from being accidentally resized into a cramped layout that breaks internal cards or controls., **Stable Block Header Controls**: Reverted experimental block heading click collapse behavior to the stable standard design, ensuring reliable input editing and smooth segment card folding via the chevron toggle and preview bar.
